name: @nolit/dsh-antigravity-directsdk
description: Antigravity subscription pure LLM adapter for DeepSeek Harness: an `antigravity` provider route that calls cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent directly with the Antigravity consumer OAuth credential (refresh-token grant, client id/secret overridable). Streaming text/thought/tool-call deltas, per-call usage with reasoning tokens, dynamic model serving with per-model quota. No CLI, no spawn, no agent persona.
author: nolit
